notes: IBM's CICS asynchronous API credit-card example: GETNAME (the customer-name lookup, transaction GETN). GET CONTAINER(INPUTCONTAINER); '0001' is PRADEEP GOHIL, any other JOE BLOGS; PUT CONTAINER(GETNAMECONTAINER) the 80-byte name; RETURN. Its LINKAGE SECTION is empty: no COMMAREA ("commarea": null). The task starts with the channel its caller passes (#4270, oracle_assumptions.md X24): MYCHANNEL holding INPUTCONTAINER, the 4-byte account number ASYNCPNT / SEQPNT PUT there (no DATATYPE: BIT). The containers the task leaves on MYCHANNEL are compared at its end, as the caller sees them after FETCH CHILD / its LINK. scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: no channel: GET CONTAINER without CHANNEL has no current channel -- INVREQ RESP2 4 (caught by RESP), ACCOUNT-NUMBER-IN keeps its initial value (no VALUE clause: oracle_assumptions.md L3) so the ELSE branch runs; PUT CONTAINER is INVREQ RESP2 4 too, then RETURN; there is no channel, so nothing more to compare
